integrity: Analytic proofs and a reproducible finite diagnostic checker are supplied; no independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nondegenerate positive-radius coaxial circular frusta and orthographic projections only.
Asymptotic coefficients are not uniform as radii coalesce or a rim degenerates.
The inverse requires noiseless angle-labeled population observables; finite-sample stability is unproved.
The qualitative ellipse/tangent silhouette classification is existing knowledge, not a new claim.
Historical equivalence in uninspected specialist projection literature is possible.
title: Two sharp silhouette-contact laws and local inverse geometry for circular frusta
